J&K LG Appoints Kin of Slain Policemen

Jammu and Kashmir Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha presented appointment letters to the families of two deceased police personnel. The letters were given to the next of kin of Inspector Masroor Ali Wani and another slain policeman. This action is part of a compassionate appointment initiative.
